Mesh studio port parity (solidify group-inheritance one-face, merge pure-regroup leaving seam verts/edges, face-mode loop cut neighbor-normal heuristic slant, edge-mode midpoint-walk slant, and their compounding — bad groups force the bad fallback). Facade painter (yaw-front side selection with no picker, missing alpha handling occluding wall textures, single-select auto-gather violating the req_3062 explicit-selection ruling, and shift-click multi-select dead on arrival — modifier state never packed into the JS pointer payload). Root cause ruled and saved to memory: substrate-cheap re-expression shipped under 'port' with no parity enforcement. Delivered the itemized fix bill A-H (modifier bridge, facade scope/alpha/side, solidify identities, merge dissolve, parametric loop cut, parity harness) with size estimates; awaiting the user's go on all or a subset. Summary only, no code changed.
